editorial: When the elevator doors part at midnight, you feel the weight of your own survival pressing up and down. In this psychological thriller, the architects of food allocation manifest as a living ecosystem, turning each elevator stop into a microscopic crucible. Joaquin Phoenix channels a silent fury, his presence a constant, whispered threat that keeps the audience breathing on edge. A sluggish stretch lingers halfway through, pulling the tension into a drag. You’ll crave this if you enjoy cinema that unspools consciousness like a needle through blood.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
